cli_checks.stdout:
usage: main.py [-h]
               {plan,generate,inspect-dataset,analyze,dataset,describe,audit,validate,run,batch}
               ...

Managed local multi-UAV SITL scenarios

positional arguments:
  {plan,generate,inspect-dataset,analyze,dataset,describe,audit,validate,run,batch}
    plan                Compile an explicit TaskSpec to event-driven AUTO
                        phases
    generate            Generate bounded deterministic mission candidates
                        without launching SITL
    inspect-dataset     Validate observation loading and summarize a frozen
                        dataset
    analyze             Write a new, versioned analysis of an existing run
    dataset             Export analyzed runs with whole-family splits; retain
                        failures
    describe            Export manifest-bound Chinese descriptions beside a
                        frozen dataset
    audit               Read-only check of a legacy trajectory JSON

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

limitations: 验证新的独立文件路径中的启动前依赖，不等于已在另一台物理电脑飞行；不验证历史批量接续或全量归档集成测试
